source.original_question:
As shown in the figure, then the minimum area of the square PQRS is ()
Choices:
A:7
B:8
C:9
D:10

adaptations.reason: The source supplies no motion/orientation conditions and its answer 8 is not implied by the visible radius 1 and centre-to-line distance 3. Explicitly specified the natural Q-on-circle/P-on-line family and independently obtained 4; updated one option and answer without changing the diagram goal.

independent_solution.method: The shortest segment between circle O (radius 1) and line L (distance 3 from O) has length 3-1=2. This segment can be a side of a square, hence minimum square area is 2²=4.
